notes.title: Developer Update: Exciting News for Deadrock Redemption Fans!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow gamers!

We're thrilled to announce a significant milestone in the development of Deadrock Redemption: the release of our small single quest demo featuring one of the captivating characters from the game, Amber!

As you dive into this exclusive demo, you'll get a taste of the immersive world of Deadrock and a glimpse into the compelling narrative that awaits in the full release. Join Amber on a thrilling quest that will test your wit, courage, and resolve as you navigate the rugged terrain of Deadrock.

But that's not all! We're gearing up for the highly anticipated full release of Deadrock Redemption on March 14. Mark your calendars, because this is an adventure you won't want to miss!

And here's the cherry on top: in anticipation of the full release, we're offering a special 15% launch discount to players who Wishlist Deadrock Redemption on their preferred gaming platform. That's right, by Wishlist-ing now, you'll not only secure your copy of the game but also enjoy exclusive savings on launch day!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753270/Deadrock_Redemption/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753270/Deadrock_Redemption/[/url]

So, what are you waiting for? Embark on the journey of a lifetime, explore the vast wilderness of Deadrock, and uncover the secrets that lie beneath its rugged exterior.

Wishlist Deadrock Redemption today and prepare to experience an unforgettable adventure on March 14!

Stay tuned for more updates and exciting announcements as we count down to launch day.

Happy gaming!

The Deadrock Redemption Development Team

notes.title: Post Launch Update : Multiple Save Slots
notes.notes:
Horny Housewives Update v1.221 - Multiple Save Slots

After reviewing feedback after the first month or release for Horny Housewives, the overwhelmingly most requested feature missing in the game was the ability to have multiple save points. We listened to the feedback and made that feature a priority for the next major update. 

Today that update patch in being added to the game build to allow players to save multiple games and allow them to jump to any point in the game story. This build also includes some visual and sound hotfixes for minor issues that were detected since the last build release. 

[list]
[*] Fixed delay in movie playback
[*] character meshes fixed in some pre-rendered scenes
[*] Corrected Typos in dialogue
[/list]

notes.title: Horny Housewives - Developer Launch Release Update
notes.notes:
Horny Housewives - Developer Launch Release Update

Dear Adventurers,

We're thrilled to share the latest developments and sneak peeks of our upcoming RPG game, "Horny Housewives." Our team has been hard at work crafting an immersive experience that blends captivating storytelling, realistic 3D interactions, and a vibrant cast of characters that will bring the neighborhood to life.

[b]Meet the Characters:[/b]

1. [b]Anna[/b] - The Enchanting Florist:
   - A mysterious florist with a passion for botany and a secret longing for connection. Uncover her past and help her find love amidst the flowers.

2. [b]Leo[/b] - The Charming Musician:
   - A gay man who thrives on the energy of the town. Discover his hidden talents and assist him in forming unique connections through the power of his observations of the housewives.

3. [b]Emily[/b] - The Emotional Explorer:
   - A psychology enthusiast on a quest to understand the intricacies of human emotions. Dive deep into her quest and help her navigate the complexities of her own heart.

4. [b]Mark [/b]- The Troubled Romantic:
   - A neighbor struggling to mend a fractured relationship. Assist Mark in overcoming obstacles and rediscovering the spark with his wife, Sarah.

5. [b]Claire[/b] - The Fitness Enthusiast:
   - A health-conscious individual with a penchant for smoothies and a commitment to a fit lifestyle. Embark on fitness quests, join Claire on runs, and explore the benefits of a healthy lifestyle.

6. [b]Eric [/b]- The Curious Observer:
   - A neighbor caught in the crossfire of neighborhood rumors. Navigate through his perspective as he seeks the truth behind the gossip.

[b]Immersive 3D Interaction:[/b]

- Dynamic Environments:
  Explore a richly detailed suburban landscape, complete with lush parks, bustling streets, and charming homes and backyards. Every corner tells a story, and every choice influences the narrative.

- Realistic Interactions:
  Engage with characters through realistic 3D interactions. From helping Anna arrange her enchanting bouquets to joining Claire on a jog through the neighborhood, every action has consequences.

- Player Choices:
  Shape the narrative through your decisions. Forge friendships, spark romances, or delve into the mysteries of the neighborhood. The power is in your hands.

Compelling Storylines:

- Love and Intrigue:
  Uncover hidden desires, secret affairs, and unexpected connections as you navigate through intricate storylines that blur the lines between romance and mystery.

- Neighborhood Drama:
  Become a part of the community as you witness and influence the drama that unfolds between neighbors. Gossip, romance, and unexpected twists await.

[b]What's Coming:[/b]

We can't wait for you to experience "Horny Housewives" and become a part of this vibrant virtual community. Stay tuned for the official launch, and get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure filled with love, drama, and unexpected connections.

Happy adventuring!

The "Horny Housewives" Development Team
